questions.prompt: Before training, what should you do with a random sample of audio/text pairs?
options: Listen and compare the text against the audio
questions.explanation: Spot checks reveal clipping, silence, transcript mismatch and inconsistent recording quality.

questions.prompt: Does a publicly downloadable voice dataset automatically permit every commercial use?
options: No; inspect its terms and relevant permissions
Yes; public access means unrestricted use
Yes; a citation replaces all permissions
questions.explanation: Availability is not a grant of every usage right. The lesson asks you to verify the actual dataset terms and speaker permissions.

questions.prompt: A forced aligner produces timestamps. What does that establish?
options: Proof that the transcript is correct
Proof that synthesis will be natural
An alignment hypothesis that still needs inspection
questions.explanation: Alignment conditions on the supplied transcript. Bad transcripts can still yield plausible-looking timestamps.
